description: Sign in with GitHub for the Singularity IDE. Independent of Copilot and of any AI subscription.
configuration.title: Singularity Account
configuration.githubClientId: Client ID of the Singularity GitHub OAuth App (public, not a secret). Empty: GitHub sign-in is unavailable in this build.
publish.defaultMode: Default publishing mode for repositories: manual (nothing is pushed by the IDE) or assisted (asks before pushing). Automatic is only enabled per repository in singularity.publish.automaticRepositories.
publish.mode.manual: Nothing is pushed by the IDE.
publish.mode.assisted: Asks before pushing commits that are ahead of the upstream.
publish.automaticRepositories: Repository folders allowed to push automatically after each commit. Machine scope: a repository cannot enable this for itself through its own settings file.
